articles.title: Trump puts off threat to bomb Iran power grid, Iranian agency denies report of talks to end war

articles.title: UK Air Chief Marshal Smyth hails move for IAF to train Royal Air Force pilots
articles.summary: Britain's Air Chief Marshal Sir Harv Smyth recently lauded a new initiative enabling the Indian Air Force to train pilots from the UK's Royal Air Force. This significant development, announced in New Delhi, aims to bolster bilateral defence cooperation and strategic ties between India and the UK. The move underscores increasing mutual trust and a shared commitment to enhancing aerial capabilities through joint training and expertise exchange.

articles.title: NavIC: India's "jinxed" navigational program, or a cornerstone of India's misplaced space priorities?
articles.summary: India's NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation) is an indigenous regional satellite navigation system providing accurate positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) services across India and surrounding areas. It significantly enhances national strategic autonomy, reducing reliance on foreign systems like GPS. This capability is crucial for critical infrastructure, defence applications, and various economic sectors, bolstering India's self-reliance in vital navigation technology.
